propositions: macOS CI snapshot tests fail during cleanup because read-only .rebar/run_snapshots directories cannot be removed by standard shutil.rmtree after successful test execution
snapshot-producing tests in any module outside tests/unit/workflow/test_snapshot.py leave non-removable read-only snapshot trees because cleanup is owned only by a module-local fixture
production snapshot publication intentionally applies 0444/0555 permissions via snapshot._chmod_readonly, and the existing snapshot._rmtree_writable seam can restore writability to enable cleanup
shared pytest teardown must centrally search below each test-owned tmp_path for exact .rebar/run_snapshots roots and apply _rmtree_writable before pytest attempts basetemp removal
cleanup must preserve production snapshot read-only state during test execution and leave unrelated temp content in tmp_path untouched after removing snapshot cache roots
